BiblicalUsage: The word names a granary or storehouse, and Jeremiah uses it once, in the oracle against Babylon: open her storehouses, cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly. The storehouse that once held plenty becomes the spoil of judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the storehouse warns us that plenty hoarded against God becomes plunder, and no granary is safer than the hand of the LORD.
